Interpolation

Source: R/utils-interpolation.R
interpolate.Rd

Calculate rates by linear interpolation

Usage

interpolate(
  nagg,
  matrix,
  rates,
  next_rate,
  last_rate,
  npred,
  nagg_proj_year,
  ny_proj
)

Arguments

nagg

Number of years for data aggregation (by years). Default is 1-annual data.

matrix

Base matrix to work off of.

rates

Matrix of rates for predicted periods.

next_rate

Calculated rate for extra years.

last_rate

Calculated rate for extra years.

npred

Number of predicted periods after aggregation.

nagg_proj_year

Number of aggregated projection years.

ny_proj

Number of years for preojection, not aggregated.

Value

A matrix().
